metadata.title: agent-qc.com - deterministic controls for agent output
metadata.description: A toolchain of deterministic, code-based quality gates for AI agents. No model in the loop. Less slop, more signal.

hero.title: Agents ship faster than you can
hero.body: They solve real problems - and accumulate flaws at a speed humans can no longer follow. Agents grading other agents tend to inherit the same blind spots, especially on large codebases. We ship the opposite: deterministic, code-based gates that can't be talked around.

points.title: Agents outrun review.
points.body: Output arrives in seconds. A human reading carefully takes minutes per file. The gap compounds across a sprint.

points.title: Errors compound silently.
points.body: Each generation inherits the last. Subtle defects survive because nothing structural is forcing them to surface.

points.title: Agents are bad referees.
points.body: An LLM grading another LLM shares its blind spots. Once the codebase exceeds context, the reviewer is guessing.

approach.title: Deterministic gates.
approach.body: Code-based controls aren't smarter than an agent. They don't need to be. They're rules, written once, run forever, with the same result every time.

proofs.label: can't be circumvented
proofs.body: Rules compile to code. The agent can't argue with them, can't flatter them, can't convince them it's fine this time. The gate is the contract.

proofs.label: scales infinitely
proofs.body: One token or ten million tokens - the same check runs at the same speed. No quadratic context window, no per-call cost, no rate limit.

proofs.label: context-independent
proofs.body: Determinism doesn't care what's in the repo. The check only sees what it's pointed at. Big codebase, small codebase, same verdict shape.

loop.title: Work. Gate. Report. Loop.
loop.body: The agent does the task. A gate runs. Issues report out as structured findings. The agent loops back and fixes them - until the gate exits clean.

steps.title: agent works
steps.body: writes code, writes prose, refactors, edits.

steps.title: gate runs
steps.body: deterministic checks scan the diff. Microseconds per token.

steps.title: issues reported
steps.body: structured JSON. File, line, rule, severity. Nothing fuzzy.

steps.title: agent fixes
steps.body: loop until the gate exits 0. Or the human steps in.

loop.note: loop until exit 0. no agent grading another agent. no token cost per pass. the gate is the contract.

items.name: slopless
items.tagline: Deterministic textlint rules for catching prose slop in Markdown.
items.body: 50+ rules across hedge words, AI tells, cliches, banned tokens, sentence structure. Reads stdin or a glob. Emits structured JSON findings. Exits 0/1/2. No LLM.

items.name: guardrail3
items.tagline: Composable code guardrails for Rust and TypeScript projects.
items.body: Banned-by-default architecture checks: dependency allowlists, topology rules, apparch, source scans, release readiness, test quality. Bootstraps from a profile. Self-validates.

items.name: fixture3
items.tagline: Fixture-based approval testing CLI for agent-managed codebases.
items.body: Fixtures, suites, features, tags. Approved vs received output. Fail-closed by default. DDMin reduction for shrinking failures. JSON output on every command, exit codes you can pipe into an agent.

footer.body: Deterministic controls for agent output. Less slop. More signal.
footer.legal: MIT - no telemetry - no cookies - no llm in the loop
